svg.title: Directory system service-based architecture
svg.desc: Service-based architecture for the Directory system: four coarse-grained separately deployed services — API server, Reconciler, PostgreSQL, and Zot OCI registry — composed via Docker Compose with clear service boundaries.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How do external clients call the Directory API server?')
g.text: gRPC consumers — store · routing · search · signing · naming · sync · events
Separately deployed · handles all gRPC APIs

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does the store gRPC API do in Directory?')
sendPrompt('What does the routing gRPC API do?')
sendPrompt('What does the search gRPC API do?')
sendPrompt('What does the signing gRPC API do?')
sendPrompt('What does the naming gRPC API do?')
sendPrompt('What do the sync and events gRPC APIs do?')

g.text: Separately deployed · periodic background tasks: registry sync · indexing · name verification · signature verification

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does PostgreSQL store in the Directory system?')
sendPrompt('What does the Zot OCI registry store in Directory?')

svg.text: Deployed via Docker Compose — separate containers: apiserver · reconciler · zot · postgres
